title: ipomoea antillana
intro: Ipomoea antillana, commonly known as Island Morning Glory, is a flowering plant species in the Convolvulaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiproliferative properties. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea antillana include its potential to reduce inflammation, prevent cell damage, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
